title: Believe
premise: The supplied English lyrics return to a shared sky, love and faith, then ask us to let the past go and find steadiness when the ground feels uncertain.
authorship_notes: Author supplied the song lyrics in English and requested a directing project using workflows 04–06.
Story action, staging, design, target durations and coverage are directing proposals for review.
creative_intent: Let the audience feel the grip of an unfinished goodbye, then see Lena loosen it. Bring the parents and daughter into the same composition across distance while keeping their spaces distinct.
focal_character: CH-001 · Lena, a young adult leaving home
dramatic_question: When the call goes dark, can Lena stay with the goodbye she has been trying to put off?
goal: Keep her parents with her for the first minutes of the journey.
stakes: A dropped call makes the departure feel final before she is ready to let go.
constraints: Keep the supplied song section order.
Plan generated segments at 15 seconds or less, including handles.
Lyrics only at planning. Sync points depend on the audio master.
assumptions: Lena, Zoya, Pavel and the train departure are original proposals.
16:9 landscape, no sung lip sync or required dialogue, one evening on a short stretch of the journey.
The crescent is a matched visual anchor for the same evening. Neither party can see the other after the train leaves.
open_questions: Where do the first chorus, reprise and tail land in the stereo master?
Approve the degree of intimacy in the family performance and the moon and window framing before reference-frame production.

scenes.heading: EXT. STATION PLATFORM – BLUE HOUR

sound_requirements: One gentle door close under the outgoing chorus.

scenes.heading: INT. CARRIAGE BAY / EXT. PLATFORM – EVENING
scenes.purpose: Give Lena a physical loss of place and a new tactic. Make her hands change from gripping the past to holding a call.

scenes.heading: INT. CARRIAGE BAY / EXT. PLATFORM – EVENING
scenes.purpose: Let the screen keep them close while the outside world changes. Make distance readable before the signal fails.
scenes.location: LOC-002 and LOC-001 · Two ends of the call
scenes.action_summary: Lena watches the call. The parents stand close enough to fit the same screen. The train enters a tunnel and exterior light disappears.

entry_state.summary: Phone active. Photo face up. Cool exterior visible beyond warm lamp reflection.

exit_state.summary: Phone still active on last beat. Tunnel dark outside. Warm lamp unchanged.

scenes.heading: INT. CARRIAGE BAY – TUNNEL TO OPEN AIR
scenes.purpose: Take away the old tactic. Let Lena first try to restore it, then notice the world outside the phone.
scenes.action_summary: The bay sways. Lena catches the sliding picture and the call freezes. One retry gives her no answer. Cool sky returns at the window edge.

exit_state.summary: Photo resettled face up. Dark phone still in right hand. Cool exterior has returned.

continuity.screen_direction: Keep the train moving right, outside plate left. Confine the photo slip and catch to one insert. Lamp remains on.

sound_requirements: One short rail jolt, then enclosed rolling bed.
Brief filtered call decay if space allows. No words are needed.

scenes.heading: INT. CARRIAGE BAY / EXT. PLATFORM – NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Show the change as a choice in Lena’s hands. Let the viewers share the sky before the parents and daughter do.
scenes.location: LOC-002 and LOC-001 · Window and open canopy end
scenes.action_summary: Lena sets the phone face down and turns off the lamp. She opens her right palm like Zoya. At the platform’s open end, Zoya does the same. Pavel lowers his phone.

entry_state.summary: Lamp on with a bright spot in window. Dark phone in Lena’s right hand. Parents near their original post.

exit_state.summary: Lena’s phone face down, lamp off and palm open. Parents stand side by side near the open end.

continuity.screen_direction: Use the window view to reorient, then the canopy post to mark the cut back to the platform. Same moon shape and height. The people occupy separate places.

sound_requirements: Clear lamp click if it survives the music.
Keep train and platform acoustics distinct under the chorus.

scenes.heading: EXT. PLATFORM / INT. CARRIAGE BAY – NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Leave the connection in the paired frames after the hands have let go. Keep the departure real.
scenes.location: LOC-001 and LOC-002 · Two frames of sky

exit_state.summary: Pavel’s phone pocketed. Lena’s hand relaxed and picture face up. Last image is the window’s sky.

continuity.screen_direction: Return to two already mapped edges. No new interface state, reply or viewpoint outside the established spaces.

sound_requirements: Let the arrangement fade over the last held window image.
Carry a little wheel texture under the fade.
